newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI EXPORTS RISE 23 PCT YR/YR AFTER BAHT FLOAT.
newsitem.headline: THAI EXPORTS RISE 23 PCT YR/YR AFTER BAHT FLOAT.

text.p: Thai exports rose about 23.0 percent year-on-year in July after the baht's depreciation of more than 20 percent last month, the Customs Department said on Monday.
The department estimated that July exports amounted to 140.5 billion baht ($4.5 billion).
It said July imports increased an estimated 3.5 percent year-on-year to 159.4 billion baht.
Customs department statistics are normally different from those announced later by the Bank of Thailand.
